guidance:
- Hook: rotate to **question** (1.66x) or **top3** (1.5x) — avoid comparison (overused).
- Angle: lead with a **mistake** (1.36x) small businesses make when scripting reels themselves.
- Visual: try **silhouette** or **desk-glow** style (1.5x/1.44x) — static image with text overlay works better than talking-head reels right now.
- Service focus: reel script writing — keep it broad (cafes, gyms, clinics, shops), not one niche.
- CTA: only "pay after approval" + short DM conversation. No demos, samples, guarantees.
- Posts must read like a developer sharing real work, never an ad.

instructions.research: Find 3 common reel-script mistakes Indian small businesses make (e.g., writing essays instead of spoken lines, ignoring the hook, no clear CTA). Cite no sources, just note patterns.
instructions.analysis: Compare today's reel-script topic to the 2026-11-11 post ("15-sentence essay vs 3-line framework"). Ensure new angle: focus on the *mistake* of skipping a spoken-structure, not a comparison.
instructions.writer: Write one Instagram caption (Hinglish, ≤130 words). Hook: question about a mistake. Body: 2-3 lines on the mistake + how a spoken script helps. CTA: "Pay after approval — DM me, I'll tell you if scripts fit your business." No niche, no region, no stats.
instructions.image: Create a static silhouette-style graphic: dark background, glowing phone outline showing 3 short script lines (labelled "Example"). Text overlay: "Reel script = spoken, not written." No logos, no brand names.
instructions.video: Skip video today. Static image outperforms reels per current data. If you post a reel later, keep ≤15s, hook in first 1s, caption burned in.
